title: MSA/DPA Exception Clauses Catalog and Pricing-Impact Framework
creator: Avery Collins
description: Create a structured catalog of common MSA/DPA exceptions (indemnity, liability caps, data residency, audit rights, security controls) and a corresponding pricing-impact framework that lets sales and solutions engineers quickly estimate commercial tradeoffs for each exception. Goal is to reduce legal turnaround, enable predictable concessions, and inform whether an exception should route to sales engineering, finance, or legal for escalation.
goals: Document the 20 most frequent exception clauses we see in incoming MSAs/DPAs
Map each clause to a risk tier (low/medium/high) with rationale and example redlines
Define a pricing delta formula or credit policy associated with accepted exceptions
Create a one-page cheat sheet and decision flow for AE/SEs to use during negotiations
Reduce legal review cycles for low-risk exceptions by 40% within two quarters
proposed_solution: Develop an exceptions catalog as a living doc (Confluence) + structured JSON lookup that maps clause -> risk_tier -> allowed_redline -> recommended_pricing_adjustment. Integrate the catalog into the AE/SE playbook and the deal desk triage so that low-risk exceptions are auto-approved by sales with a standard credit and high-risk items are auto-routed to Legal with pre-populated context.
flow_steps: Ingest top 50 redlines from last 12 months and tag clause types
Workshop with Legal to classify risk tier and acceptable language
Run 5 sample deals with Sales to validate pricing delta heuristics
Publish Confluence catalog and an internal one-pager cheat sheet
Add a checkbox and reference link to Deal Desk intake form to apply catalog rules
Train Sales, SEs, and Deal Desk; collect feedback for iteration
acceptance_criteria: Catalog includes at least 20 clause types with example language and rationale
Each clause has a documented risk tier and an associated pricing delta or credit rule
A published AE/SE cheat sheet and a Deal Desk decision checkbox exist
Pilot with two AE teams shows a reduction in legal review cycles for cataloged low-risk exceptions
Legal signs off on the routing rules and escalation thresholds
